lines.trans: Good evening, friends, and welcome back to Friday tea in Room Nine.
Thirty years ago in May, my aunt started a little waltz right at this piano.
Rain interrupted page two—until Qing and Chen pushed these shutters open again.
And tonight, our neighbour from number ten joins Teacher Song on the violin!
Ready on three, my friend? One, two, three...
Listen to how high the violin soars when the piano reaches middle D, Manager Zhou!
Even my glasses are misty—and for once I know right where they are!
Look outside: people walking down Wutong Lane have stopped by the gate to listen!
And there is our gentle final chord, one octave high—home again.
Bravo! Bravo, Teacher Song! Hear the whole courtyard clapping!
Take a bow yourself, Manager Zhou—your aunt's Friday room is alive again.
And nobody wants to go home yet—time for the cinnamon rolls!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì qǐ. Placed right before the verb to mean 'together' (一起吃晚饭 'have dinner together').

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
examples.trans: Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng yāng. Compound 中 ('middle') + 央 ('center'); also used in music for the middle register (中央八度 'middle octave').

examples.text: 院子中央摆着一张干净的木头圆桌。
examples.trans: A clean round wooden table stands in the center of the courtyard.

examples.text: 请把手放在钢琴键盘的中央。
examples.trans: Please place your hands at the center of the piano keyboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ yuè. Fifth month of the year ('month five').

examples.text: 五月的成都院子里到处都是花香。
examples.trans: In May, courtyards in Chengdu are filled with the scent of flowers everywhere.

examples.text: 这张旧照片是五月的一个晴天拍的。
examples.trans: This old photo was taken on a sunny day in May.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn wǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天晚上 ('this evening').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: men. Attaches to pronouns (我们, 你们, 他们) and human nouns (孩子们).

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

examples.text: 我梦寐以求的咖啡馆，就开在自家庭院里！等着瞧我去告诉整条街的人吧！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tíng. Used for vehicles pulling up, rain stopping, or pausing an action.

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán. Emphasizes entirety before 都 or a verb (全都 'every single one').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā dù. Musical interval of eight scale degrees: 八 ('eight') + 度 ('degree/interval').

examples.text: 请把这段旋律升高一个八度再弹一次。
examples.trans: Please raise this melody by one octave and play it again.

examples.text: 钢琴中央八度的音色最温暖。
examples.trans: The tone of the piano's middle octave is the warmest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài jiàn. Standard Mandarin farewell at any time of day.

examples.text: 路上小心，我们明天再见！
examples.trans: Take care on the road—see you again tomorrow!

examples.text: 谢谢您的帮忙，再见！
examples.trans: Thank you for your help—goodbye!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐ. Asks about small numbers (几点 'what time', 几个 'how many') before a measure word.

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 那家五金店早上几点开门？
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Cardinal number 10; building block for 11–99.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.en: mouth; doorway; measure word for sips/breaths
meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu. Counts mouthfuls of food/tea, breaths of air (一口气), or family members.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

合奏.gloss: play music together; perform in ensemble

meanings.en: play music together; perform in ensemble
meanings.note: Pinyin: hé zòu. Combines 合 ('join together') + 奏 ('play music'); also used as a noun for an instrumental ensemble.

examples.text: 他就是当年每个星期五跟您姑姑合奏的音乐老师！
examples.trans: He is the very music teacher who used to play Friday duets with your aunt back then!

examples.text: 小提琴和核桃木钢琴在阳光房里合奏出温暖的旋律。
examples.trans: The violin and the walnut piano played a warm melody together in the sunroom.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé xián. Combines 和 ('harmonious/together') + 弦 ('musical string'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 最后一个温柔的和弦，高一个八度——又回家了。
examples.trans: And there is our gentle final chord, one octave higher—home again.

examples.text: 宋老师在钢琴上轻轻弹下第一个温暖的大调和弦。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently played the first warm major chord on the piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎr. Spoken northern/standard variant of 哪里 ('where').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí. As a verb, 'return' (回家, 回来); as a measure word, 'occasion/time' (这回 'this time').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí jiā. Verb-object compound 回 ('return') + 家 ('home'); takes no location particle between them.

examples.text: 买完菜以后，我们一起走路回家吧。
examples.trans: After finishing the grocery shopping, let's walk home together.

examples.text: 下班回家的路上，我买了一束鲜花。
examples.trans: On my way home from work, I bought a bunch of fresh flowers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán wǔ qǔ. Compound from 圆 ('circle') + 舞 ('dance') + 曲 ('musical piece'). Measure word: 首 (shǒu).

examples.text: 宋老师在钢琴上弹了一首轻快的圆舞曲。
examples.trans: Teacher Song played a lively waltz on the piano.

examples.text: 这首老圆舞曲让人想起三十年前的晚茶会。
examples.trans: This old waltz brings back memories of evening tea gatherings thirty years ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 外面世界 ('the outside').

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō. Means 'many' as an adjective, 'how…?' before adjectives (多大), or 'more than' after round numbers (三十多).

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇大门 ('a front gate').

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà yǔ. Measure word (量词): 场 (chǎng), e.g. 一场大雨 ('a heavy rainstorm').

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 外面的大雨下了整整一个晚上。
examples.trans: The heavy downpour outside lasted the entire night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài. Often frames 太 + adj + 了 for warm exclamations (太好了！ 'Wonderful!').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū gu. Specifically father's sister (second syllable neutral tone); distinct from 阿姨 / 姨妈 (mother's sister).

examples.text: 周经理的姑姑以前也住在这座老院子里。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's paternal aunt used to live in this old courtyard too.

examples.text: 我姑姑年轻的时候最喜欢弹钢琴。
examples.trans: When my aunt was young, she loved playing the piano most of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular pronoun for objects, animals, and places.

examples.text: 是啊，宋老师，还在等它的主人呢。
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, still waiting for its owner.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo tí qín. Combines 小 ('small') + 提 ('hold/carry in hand') + 琴 ('stringed instrument'); measure word: 把 (bǎ).

examples.text: 三十年前，每个星期五傍晚他都带着一把小提琴来九号房。
examples.trans: Thirty years ago, every Friday evening he brought a violin to Room Nine.

examples.text: 老先生答应星期五带上小提琴，和宋老师的钢琴一起合奏。
examples.trans: The elderly gentleman promised to bring his violin on Friday and play a duet with Teacher Song's piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi shǐ. Everyday verb for starting work, breakfast, or a lesson.

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tán. Used for playing the piano or guitar (弹钢琴 'play the piano').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

扇.gloss: measure word for doors and windows

meanings.en: measure word for doors and windows
meanings.note: Pinyin: shàn. Counts hinged or sliding doors and windows (一扇门 'a door', 一扇窗户 'a window').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

meanings.note: Verb-complement dǎduàn ('interrupt someone speaking').

examples.text: 孙总，你突然打断嘉宾说话是干什么？
examples.trans: Mr Sun, why interrupt our guests mid-sentence?

examples.text: 别人发言的时候请不要随意打断。
examples.trans: Please do not interrupt while others are speaking.

meanings.note: Noun zhǎngshēng ('clapping, applause').

examples.text: 下面让我们用热烈的掌声欢迎米娜先生！
examples.trans: Let us welcome Mr Mina with warm applause!

examples.text: 一曲唱罢，演播厅里响起了经久不息的掌声。
examples.trans: As the song ended, lasting applause filled the studio.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuī. Opposite of 拉 ('pull'); used for pushing doors open.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 这扇木门往里推就开了。
examples.trans: Push this wooden door inward and it opens.

meanings.note: Noun shù ('count; certainty in 心里有数').

examples.text: 你以为雷总心里一点数都没有吗？
examples.trans: Do you think Director Lei has no idea what goes on?

examples.text: 经费还剩多少，我心里有数。
examples.trans: I have a clear count of how much budget remains.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí hou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这个时候 ('this moment').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn shang hǎo. Polite evening greeting formed from 晚上 ('evening') + 好 ('good/well').

examples.text: 朋友们晚上好，欢迎回到九号房的星期五晚茶。
examples.trans: Good evening, friends, and welcome back to Friday evening tea in Room Nine.

examples.text: 晚上好，周经理，院子里的大圆桌还空着吗？
examples.trans: Good evening, Manager Zhou—is the big round table in the courtyard still free?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn chá. Compound 晚 ('evening') + 茶 ('tea'): an early-evening tea gathering with light pastries.

examples.text: 三十年前，客栈每个星期五都办花园晚茶。
examples.trans: Thirty years ago, the inn hosted garden evening tea every Friday.

examples.text: 晚茶时间到了，小美端出了一盘刚烤好的柠檬塔。
examples.trans: When evening tea time arrived, Mei brought out a tray of freshly baked lemon tarts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì hòu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最后一个 ('the last one').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: péng you. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个朋友 ('a friend').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 今天有两位老朋友从外地来看我。
examples.trans: Two old friends are visiting me from out of town today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí le. Follows directly after an adjective to boost it to the max (棒极了！ 'amazing!', 热极了 'super hot!').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

架.gloss: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

meanings.en: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines
meanings.note: Pinyin: jià. Counts pianos, airplanes, and framed instruments (一架钢琴 'a piano').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 客厅角落里放着一架老钢琴。
examples.trans: An old piano stands in the corner of the living room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàng. Warm colloquial adjective for praising food, work, or ideas (太棒了！).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 太棒了！用钢笔把你的名字正式写进老陈的大纸本子里！
examples.trans: Wonderful! Your name goes into Chen's big paper ledger in fountain-pen ink!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huān yíng. Warm greeting to arriving guests (欢迎！ / 欢迎光临！).

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huó. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件活儿 ('a piece of work').

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 手里的活做完就可以休息了。
examples.trans: Once we finish the work in hand, we can rest.

related.gloss: a piece of work (measure word 件)

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn róu. Describes a gentle melody, warm voice, or kind manner.

examples.text: 这首圆舞曲的开头温柔得像春天的微风。
examples.trans: The opening of this waltz is as gentle as a spring breeze.

examples.text: 宋老师说话的声音总是很温柔。
examples.trans: Teacher Song's speaking voice is always gentle and warm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ruì yīn. Combines Chinese solfège 瑞 (ruì, 'Re / D') + 音 ('musical note').

examples.text: 第二十八小节的旋律正好稳稳落在中央瑞音上！
examples.trans: The melody in bar twenty-eight lands squarely on middle D!

examples.text: 修好轴销以后，中央瑞音终于重新发出了清脆的声音。
examples.trans: Once the hinge pin was fixed, middle D finally rang out clearly again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí dào. Combines 直 ('straight') + 到 ('reach/until').

examples.text: 志豪决定留在成都，直到星期五的开幕之夜。
examples.trans: Hao decided to stay in Chengdu right until Friday's opening night.

examples.text: 这场大雨从半夜一直下，直到第二天中午才停。
examples.trans: This heavy rain fell from midnight until noon the next day before stopping.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jìng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副眼镜 ('a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

related.gloss: a pair of glasses (measure word 副)

知道.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.en: know (a fact or piece of information)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī dào. Contrast 认识 ('know a person or place').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng bǎn. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗板 ('a shutter').

examples.text: 外面的窗板都关着，所以在院子里谁也没发现！
examples.trans: The shutters outside are all closed, so nobody in the courtyard ever noticed!

examples.text: 还有六天：擦玻璃，刷窗板，烤柠檬蛋糕！
examples.trans: Six days left: clean the glass, paint the shutters, bake lemon cake!

examples.text: 这是第二啊。
examples.trans: This is second.

examples.text: 那个第二好。
examples.trans: That second is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ér qiě. Adds a further supporting point.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ròu guì juǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个肉桂卷 ('a cinnamon roll').

examples.text: 宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jǐ. Follows pronouns to stress 'by oneself' (你自己 'you yourself').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

舍不得.gloss: be reluctant to part with; linger fondly

meanings.en: be reluctant to part with; linger fondly
meanings.note: Pinyin: shě bu de. Idiomatic potential compound 舍 ('give up/leave') + 不得 ('cannot bear to').

examples.text: 好朋友围着最后一杯热茶聊天，谁都舍不得走。
examples.trans: Good friends gathered around their last cup of hot tea, reluctant to leave.

examples.text: 这盘柠檬挞太香了，老陈都舍不得一口吃完。
examples.trans: This plate of lemon tart is so fragrant that Chen couldn't bear to finish his slice in one bite.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间茶室 ('a tea room').

examples.text: 我想起来了！我十岁的时候，叔叔叫它冬天茶室！
examples.trans: Now I remember! When I was ten, my uncle called it the winter tea room!

examples.text: 下午，客人们喜欢在茶室里聊天。
examples.trans: In the afternoon, guests like to chat in the tea room.

meanings.en: should; ought to; be someone's turn
meanings.note: Pinyin: gāi. Short everyday form of 应该 ('should').

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 热茶和柠檬蛋糕！小晴，你该给紧张的弟弟开个学校。
examples.trans: Hot tea and lemon cake! Qing, you ought to open a school for nervous brothers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

起雾.gloss: fog up; mist over; become foggy

meanings.en: fog up; mist over; become foggy
meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ wù. Separable verb-object compound 起 ('rise/form') + 雾 ('fog/mist'), used for weather or steamed-up glasses and windows.

examples.text: 连我的眼镜都起雾了——而且这一回我知道它在哪儿！
examples.trans: Even my glasses have fogged up—and this time I know right where they are!

examples.text: 热茶端上来的时候，玻璃窗上轻轻起雾了。
examples.trans: When the hot tea was carried out, the glass windowpanes gently misted over.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lù rén. Combines 路 ('road/street') + 人 ('person'); measure word: 位 (wèi) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 快看外面：走在梧桐巷上的路人，都停在大门口听了！
examples.trans: Look outside: passers-by walking down Wutong Lane have all stopped by the front gate to listen!

examples.text: 木牌挂出去不到十分钟，就有好几位路人停下来看菜单。
examples.trans: Less than ten minutes after the wooden sign was hung out, several passers-by stopped to read the menu.

躬.gloss: bow (of the body, in 鞠躬)

meanings.en: bow (of the body, in 鞠躬)
meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng. Bound noun object of the separable verb 鞠躬 ('to bow'); 鞠个躬 means 'take a bow'.

examples.text: 周经理，快鞠个躬，笑着把菜单卡片发给大家吧！
examples.trans: Take a bow, Manager Zhou, and hand out the menu cards to everyone with a smile!

examples.text: 演出结束的时候，宋老师和老先生一起向大家鞠了一个躬。
examples.trans: When the performance ended, Teacher Song and the older gentleman took a bow together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò lái. Directional compound moving across toward the speaker.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lín jū. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位邻居 ('a neighbor').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chóng xīn. Read chóng here; placed before a verb to redo it from scratch (重新打开 'reopen').

examples.text: 等等——你想下星期五六点，重新打开九号房？
examples.trans: Wait—you want to reopen Room Nine next Friday at six?

examples.text: 写错了没关系，重新写一遍。
examples.trans: It's fine if you made a mistake; write it again from the start.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 前院种着花草，后院十分安静。
examples.trans: Flowers grow in the front yard, and the back courtyard is quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

鞠.gloss: bow (the body in respect, in 鞠躬)

meanings.en: bow (the body in respect, in 鞠躬)
meanings.note: Pinyin: jū. Verb component of the separable compound 鞠躬 ('to bow'); takes aspect/measure words before 躬 (鞠个躬 'take a bow').

examples.text: 周经理，快鞠个躬，笑着把菜单卡片发给大家吧！
examples.trans: Take a bow, Manager Zhou, and hand out the menu cards to everyone with a smile!

examples.text: 小美笑着给鼓掌的邻居们鞠了个躬。
examples.trans: Smiling, Mei took a bow for the applauding neighbours.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè. Counts pages directly without 个 (第二页 'page two').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

examples.text: 上个月你三天绕地球飞了一整圈，回来开电话会议，中文英文一个字没错过。
examples.trans: Last month you flew around the globe in three days and took a bilingual conference call without missing a single word!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

首.gloss: measure word for songs and poems

meanings.en: measure word for songs and poems
meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Counts songs, poems, and pieces of music (一首歌 'a song').

examples.text: 老陈，好好修一次老钢琴，它会记得每一首歌。
examples.trans: Chen, repair an old piano properly once, and it will remember every song.

examples.text: 宋老师给我们弹了一首老歌。
examples.trans: Teacher Song played an old song for us.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo. Describes tall people, high ceilings, or high scores.

examples.text: 让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
examples.trans: Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?
